notes.title: Update 3 released
notes.content:
Hi,

Just published today the 3rd update

- New 5 story levels with a new scenario: The city
- Bug fixes and improvements.

We're happy to continue irmproving the game and fixing all the problems reported in the game forums: http://steamcommunity.com/app/639280/discussions/

Next week we'll back with new missions and surprises. Stay tunned!
